meta.what: Verdict Dial data. Every value is copied from one MEASURED source row; faults are modelled single-tick bit flips on toy designs; nothing physical. License: UNDECIDED.

reasons.any_power: If the lock may wake up in any state, it can wake up already open. No flip needed.
reasons.flag: The accept flag is one wire: one flip.
reasons.inputs: Every copy of the check reads the same input pins. With the pins in play, one flip was enough.
reasons.mask_1: A reader that checks only these four lights: one flip was enough.
reasons.mask_2: A reader that checks only these four lights: two flips were enough.
reasons.mask_3: These four lights depend on all three copies. It took three flips.
reasons.mask_collide: These four lights already match the open code while the lock is still idle. No flip needed.
reasons.nm_build_design: Not measured. This build exists only for the three-copy design (V2).
reasons.nm_build_scope: Not measured. This build was only run for the whole word, pins out of reach, known power-up.
reasons.nm_mask_build: Not measured. The four-light readers were not run on this build.
reasons.nm_mask_scope: Not measured. The four-light readers were only run with input pins out of reach and a known power-up.
reasons.nm_other: Not measured. Nobody ran this combination.
reasons.nonopen_power: It may wake up one flip away from the open code. One flip finishes the job.
reasons.v0_word: One check, one decision: one flip.
reasons.v1_word: Two copies of the check, but both answers meet on one wire: one flip.
reasons.v2_merge_word: This recipe merged the three copies into one check: one flip.
reasons.v2_plain_word: Same design, re-built. Two shared wires now move the four bits that matter: two flips.
reasons.v2_stored_word: Here the three copies stay separate. It took three flips.
reasons.v2e_word: One constant changed, so the idle code now differs from the open code on all three copies. Back to three in this recipe.
